scope: guest ownership hardening after audit of four P1 failures

fixes.enqueue_identity: queue only when no account token; existing account keeps own token
fixes.server_boundary: get_client_id takes ProgressOwner lock before GuestClaim check; claim re-checks after same lock
fixes.queue_persistence: merge stored records by record id; remove by id without deleting other records
fixes.stale_marker: markers older than 60 seconds discarded before registration
fixes.single_send: sendOnce keyed by record id shares immediate and retry sends
fixes.record_binding: record keeps guest id and transition id; target token subject must match confirmed target

build_workspace_temp.note: Windows temp path; not a clean-CI proof

covered_cases: guest save in flight blocks registration
save starting during registration is queued
unrelated account B is not queued under a guest transition
lost registration response retains record; guest-claim retry path
two module instances merge queue by id
concurrent retries send one POST per record in one page
not_accepted: two normal browser tabs (pre-claim in-flight, simultaneous enqueue, B switch, close/reopen, >15s, lost response with queue)
cross-tab database-atomic dedupe for every write endpoint
sanitization: No tokens, signed URLs, passwords, raw audio, or private transcripts stored.
